messages:
ashwin: Quick question — customer running Private in their VPC wants audit logs retained for 5 years and wants us to support KMS key rotation policy that rotates every 90 days. What do we currently support on the on‑prem package? @sophie @maria

sophie: We support KMS integration with customer-managed keys, but rotation frequency depends on their KMS. For on‑prem HSM flows we can trigger blind rewraps; 90d is aggressive but doable. Need to check our tooling for automating rewrap without downtime.

maria: For retention: our audit pipeline can ship to S3/GCS or to customer syslog. 5y is fine but we need to warn about storage/cost and ensure logs are tamper-evident (append-only hashes).

ashwin: Also they're asking to add a CI service account to read audit logs for a compliance job. That sounds risky — propose a scoped role that only allows read on a dedicated compliance bucket/path. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jorge: +1 scoped role. Don't give CI broad read on cluster audit stream. Ideally we export to a read-only bucket and grant the CI SA only that bucket path.

elaine: Related: we should attach an auditor role via short-lived creds (STS) rather than permanent IAM user. Bring up rotation and audit trail when granting.

sec-bot: ALERT: new vuln advisory for edge-collector v1.3.2 — path traversal after processing archive metadata. See https://security.example.com/advisories/EC-2025-009. Marking affected components in private builds.

ashwin: Ugh. Is edge-collector included in the on‑prem bundle for customers running minimal footprint? Could cause a data exfil path if misconfigured.

maria: Some customers include it. We pushed a patch last week but not everyone upgraded. Action: blocklist older container image tags in the private artifact registry and add a runtime CVE guard in the deploy manifest.

jorge: For mitigation we can add a NetworkPolicy to isolate collector pods from control-plane and from any hostPath mounts. Example we can push to their cluster via bootstrap: 

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: collector-isolation
  namespace: redwood-edge
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app: edge-collector
  policyTypes:
  - Ingress
  - Egress
  ingress:
  - from:
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: monitoring
  egress:
  - to:
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.0.0.0/8
    - podSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: storage
```

ashwin: Nice. Also want an explicit guarantee in our docs about isolation: "control-plane traffic never egresses to tenant workloads" — can we add that to the on‑prem hardening checklist?

sophie: Yes. Add network policing, host isolation (no hostNetwork unless explicitly approved), and CRI runtime options. We should update the hardening guide and include an appendix for RBAC change requests with an approval flow.

elaine: On RBAC changes — propose this flow: PR in infra-config, automated policy lint (check for broad verbs), approval from sec and infra oncall, and a canary rollout with audit logging enabled.

ashwin: For audit logging, do we have a preserved chain of custody if customers opt to send logs to their own SIEM? Need to include signed hashes or HMAC so they can prove logs weren't modified.

maria: We can provide an optional signed log export: each batch includes an HMAC with a customer key (derived from KMS) and we publish checkpoint manifests. That satisfies tamper evidence w/o shipping keys offsite.

sec-bot: NOTE: incident response template v2 uploaded to /ops/incidents/ir-template-v2.md by @sec-team. Use PR flow for timeline ingestion.

ashwin: For the vuln triage: can we bundle a hotfix for affected customers and trigger an automated advisory email for private installs? Also recommend forced image rotation for nodes that pulled the bad tag.

jorge: Yes — hotfix image + host-level containerd purge + node restart for affected nodes. We'll prepare an emergency playbook snippet.

elaine: One more ask from the customer: proof of RBAC change logs for audits. We need to ensure kube-apiserver auditing is configured to log SubjectAccessReview and RoleBinding events. Add that to the on‑prem verifier.

maria: I'll add a check in the installer that validates auditPolicy includes - "authorization.k8s.io/v1" level entries and that the retention/rotation is configured.

ashwin: Great. Action items recap: maria to draft KMS rewrap/runbook and signed log export, jorge to prepare netpol + emergency hotfix playbook, sophie/elaine to update RBAC change approval flow and hardening checklist. I'll draft the customer reply and include timeline. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy-candidate/edge-collector-1.3.3-hotfix queued to private-ops cluster; awaiting jorge approval.

jorge: approving now. rolling patch in staging, will escalte to private channels for affected customers."
